cards.text: Big day in Jerusalem, friend. Solomon, king of Israel, has finished the house of the LORD (1 Kings 7:51), and now he calls in the elders of Israel: all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites. They're there to bring something up from Zion, the City of David.

cards.question: Solomon has gathered every leader in Israel. What are they there to bring up from Zion?

answers.text: The ark of the covenant of the LORD
The bronze serpent that Moses made
The sword that belonged to Goliath

cards.text: And all the men of Israel come together to King Solomon at the feast in the seventh month, the month of Ethanim. Friend, some days I can't get ONE batch of dough to come together, and Solomon gets ALL of Israel.

cards.question: Once all the elders of Israel arrive, King Solomon picks up the ark himself.

cards.text: The priests take up the ark, and the priests and Levites carry up the ark of the LORD, the Tent of Meeting and all its sacred furnishings. I once dropped a whole cookie tray carrying it ten steps, so I am VERY impressed.
There, in front of the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel gathered with him sacrifice sheep and oxen.

cards.question: Solomon and all Israel sacrifice sheep and oxen in front of the ark. How many?

answers.text: So many they could not be counted
Seven of each and no more

cards.text: Then the priests bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place: the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.

cards.question: The cherubim in the Most Holy Place spread their wings. What do those wings do?

answers.text: Overshadow the ark and its poles
Lift the ark up off the floor

cards.text: The ark's poles stick out far enough that their ends can be seen from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside it. And they were still there when this was written.

cards.question: What's inside the ark when the priests set it in the Most Holy Place?

answers.text: The tablets and a jar of manna

cards.question: Those stone tablets were placed in the ark by ___ at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with Israel after they came out of Egypt.

cards.text: Then the priests come out of the Holy Place, and the cloud fills the house of the LORD. I bet nobody there ever forgets this one.

cards.question: With the cloud filling the house of the LORD, the priests can't stand there to minister.
The priests can't stand there to minister, for the ___ of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.

cards.text: Then Solomon declares: “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.” And Solomon's got something to say about the house he just built.

cards.question: Solomon speaks to the LORD about the house he has built. What does he say it is?

answers.text: A place for You to dwell forever
A place for You to visit yearly
A place for You to rest awhile

cards.question: With the whole assembly of Israel standing there, King Solomon turns around and blesses only the elders.

cards.text: Solomon blesses them all and says, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David…”

Then Solomon quotes what God told his father David, going ALL the way back to the day He brought Israel out of Egypt. Friend, that's further back than the oldest takeout menu in my old junk drawer, and those menus were ANCIENT.

cards.question: God says that since He brought Israel out of Egypt, He has not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel to build a house for His Name.
God didn't choose a city. But He says He chose ___ to be over His people Israel.

cards.text: Solomon says it was in his father David's heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel. A whole HOUSE, friend, and I'm over here proud when I build a shelf that doesn't wobble.

cards.question: David wanted to build a house for God's Name. What does the LORD tell David about that?

answers.text: He did well to have it in his heart
He never should have thought of it
He must wait until he is much older

cards.question: Nevertheless, David is not the one to build it. The LORD says David's ___ will build the house for His Name.

cards.text: Now, Solomon says, the LORD has fulfilled the word He spoke: Solomon has succeeded his father David, sits on the throne of Israel, and has built the house for the Name of the LORD.

cards.question: Solomon says the ark in its new place holds the covenant of the LORD. Who does he say the LORD made that covenant with?

cards.text: Friend, set this one on the cooling rack for now. This day at the temple still has more in the oven.
